curated-fs-telma-gf-bayon: Bayon reads approachable and tight-knit, its round o's holding a constant wall all the way around. And the pair's real hook is Telma's modest thick-thin shift against curves that never swell, which favors brief wording.
curated-fs-telma-gf-carlito: Telma writes with a faint nib-pressure swell across each round letter. Carlito, tight-spaced and clear at small sizes, keeps things readable, though it would wear thin over long paragraphs (a welcome drink card is plenty).
curated-fs-telma-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Graceful Telma writes flowing letters under a high mean line, with a middling contrast like a half-turned flat brush. Carrois Gothic SC keeps every curve open, so brief lines suit it best.
curated-fs-telma-gf-farro: Farro draws a tube-like stroke with compressed ascenders. Telma handles the flowing pen-written grace while Farro supplies unvarying strokes, pleasant in brief moments such as a wedding menu.
curated-fs-telma-gf-fira-code: Telma's wide-mouthed lowercase a gives its pen-written flow away at once, beneath a high mean line. But Fira Code, precise and technical, makes it feel like handwriting beside a ruler, good for a few lines.
curated-fs-telma-gf-fjalla-one: Fjalla One packs its lowercase tight, almost like capitals. The sharpest quality is Telma's open, medium-contrast letters set against that closed, tight body, handy for a few lines like a jam jar label.
curated-fs-telma-gf-hammersmith-one: A high mean line runs through every word of Telma. Hammersmith One's rounded, cord-like strokes hold steady beside the soft-pencil shifts of Telma, and the pair is built for brief reading.
curated-fs-telma-gf-homenaje: Telma writes with thin strokes half the weight of its thick ones. Flow is what Telma does best, while Homenaje, with its tall middle zone and close-knit spacing, is best kept off lengthy text.
curated-fs-telma-gf-huninn: Telma writes in flowing pen strokes, maybe for a stock certificate. Where Telma flows with middle-ground contrast, Huninn holds a monoweight stroke and lowercase rising near cap height, made for text kept brief.
curated-fs-telma-gf-khula: Hairline to stem: Telma swells in measured steps. Khula, with its tall midsection and curves that hold their mouths open, sits quietly beside it, made for text that stays short.
